entry.title: the case for automating the boring parts
entry.content:
I keep coming back to automating the boring parts, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Automating the boring parts shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: automating the boring parts, revisited
entry.content:
I spent a while getting automating the boring parts wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Automating the boring parts shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
